source.label: Kineticist Flipper Foxtrot Rhythm Explosion rules deep dive

strategy.summary: Choose a song and difficulty, then press the white and yellow buttons as their notes reach the guides. When a ball launches, use the red flipper buttons and shoot the shot marked Shoot Here.

quickInfo.name: Start a song
quickInfo.summary: Choose one of the available songs and one of five difficulties before play begins.

quickInfo.name: Play the notes
quickInfo.summary: Press the white and yellow cabinet buttons as the matching notes reach the guides; more accurate timing scores more and restores more health.

quickInfo.name: Return the ball
quickInfo.summary: A missed note launches a ball. On Hard and Challenge, pressing an explosive note also launches one. Use the red flipper buttons and shoot the shot marked Shoot Here.

steps.text: Choose a song and one of the five difficulty levels.
Press the white and yellow cabinet buttons as the matching notes reach the guides at the top of the screen. More accurate timing scores more points and restores more health.
A missed note launches a ball. On Hard and Challenge, pressing an explosive note also launches one.

Use the red flipper buttons and shoot the shot marked Shoot Here. The marked shot awards 5,000 points and restores a large amount of health; any other shot awards 1,000 points and restores a small amount.
Continue until the song ends. Losing all health ends the song; draining a launched ball removes a large amount of health and returns play to the rhythm game.

cautions.issue: Default flippers have no hold during ball play.
cautions.response: Keep flipping and return the ball to the marked shot; do not expect to cradle it on the default difficulty settings.

strategy.simpleOverview: Flipper Foxtrot alternates between rhythm inputs and pinball shots. Match notes with the white and yellow buttons; when a ball launches, the red buttons control the flippers and Shoot Here marks the target. Choose a song and difficulty before starting that loop.
strategy.overview: Flipper Foxtrot Rhythm Explosion alternates between rhythm inputs and pinball shots. Choose a song and difficulty, match the white and yellow notes, then use the red flipper buttons when the ball launches. Shoot the marked target before returning to the rhythm sequence.
